about: Cases each PR 575 screen group runs from this checkout. Run them with live.py run --skills-at <arm commit>; the cases, fixtures, and graders stay fixed across arms. A case whose case.json sets screen binds no guide promise, gives no freshness receipt, and is graded only for the screen.

S3.not_built: the small Feature reply and PR body as its own case; hold-open-pr-run records a Feature PR body and reply through the local forge

X2.not_built: H68 (corrupted persona payload: the runner records no persona flag to grade a generic spawn against) and O42 (needs a ticking program)
